style.backgroundSystem: raw concrete walls and steps in grey #A8A6A0, alternating with flat white #FFFFFF infographic screens and carbon-black #1A1A1A chapter bands
style.iconSystem: uniform thin-line outline icons inside circles, single stroke weight, monochrome
style.lightingSystem: cool overcast daylight from upper left around 5500K for street shots; even shadowless studio light for infographic screens; soft natural shadows only
style.lockText: monochrome street-editorial fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, carbon black #1A1A1A, concrete grey #A8A6A0 with one vivid sunset-orange accent #E8622D used sparingly; cool neutral overcast daylight from upper left around 5500K for street shots and even shadowless studio light for infographic screens; bold geometric sans-serif headlines in #1A1A1A on white blocks or #FFFFFF text on dark pill labels and bands; uniform thin-line outline icons inside circles with a single stroke weight; raw concrete-wall and concrete-step urban surfaces with soft natural shadows; garment always uncluttered with natural drape and visible plaid texture; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: garment always fully visible with natural drape and readable plaid texture; stable centering; face always de-emphasized by cap shadow or crop
style.surfaceSystem: raw concrete, white painted stone steps, matte paper-like white panels
style.typography: bold geometric sans-serif; #1A1A1A pill labels on white blocks and #FFFFFF text on dark bands; no decorative fonts
